html: Howdy, I think it should be considered to reassign states 3 character abbreviations, I doubt we'll have the full 800-ish number of states listed on the wikia, the possible combinations of 2 character abbreviations is below 700. And personally I think 3 digit codes will be fun. I won't make any alternations to two letter codes until a decision comes down about it.
